# plot_percolated_cluster_meshes { #mofography.threejs_viz.plot_percolated_cluster_meshes }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-recommended">go-to</span> Percolation cluster isosurface meshes at a probe radius.

```python
threejs_viz.plot_percolated_cluster_meshes(
    percolation_history,
    distance_grid,
    regions,

    **kwargs,
```

Return Three.js mesh trace dicts (functional API).
